---
title: "Modules"
---

These modules are the brief teaching blocks we will walk through together at the start of the session. They stay posted here for review afterward and for use during real responses.

## Pre-Session Checklist

- No pre-work required; we will spend the first 10 minutes going through the pre-test and orientation, then go through the modules together.
- Bring questions from real code/RRT experiences, especially moments when resident and nursing roles felt unclear.
- Note site-specific workflow uncertainties you want clarified.

::: {.module-list}
::: {.module-item}
### 1. Leadership Skills

Practice naming who is leading, anchoring the room, stating the working plan, and inviting concern before action.

[Open slides](slides/leadership.html)
:::

::: {.module-item}
### 2. Pulse-Check Decisions

Practice preparing pulse checks, making shock/no-shock calls, protecting compression pauses, and using EtCO2 or other signs when ROSC is uncertain.

[Open slides](slides/pulse_check.html)
:::

::: {.module-item}
### 3. Working with Nurse-Led Response Teams

Practice aligning bedside nursing, outreach nursing, and resident medical leadership in the first 60 seconds: role clarity, nursing trajectory, shared plan, orders, ownership, and escalation trigger.

[Open slides](slides/nurse_response.html)
:::

::: {.module-item}
### 4. Escalation, Disposition, and Closure

Practice deciding when the current room is unsafe, activating the right resource early, naming disposition, assigning ownership, and closing the event.

[Open slides](slides/escalation_closure.html)
:::
:::
